notes.title: MMA Life Sim 38000+ game downloads already
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728741/0048ce9740d7b7bef146334c228a72c556f43013.png[/img]


[b][h2]🎉 38,000+ Downloads — Thank You for the Support![/h2][/b]

We're excited to share that the updated free version of MMA Life Simulator has already been downloaded over 38,000 times—completely exhausting the bandwidth we purchased on MediaFire!

This milestone is especially meaningful to me as a solo developer—handling all aspects of the game from art, writing, and design over the past two years. It's been a challenging but rewarding journey.

What makes this achievement even more special is that it was done with zero marketing budget. Every download, every player, every bit of feedback has come organically—through your support and word-of-mouth. Thank you.

[b]
📥 Download the Latest Free Version
You can grab the most recent free version of the game here:
[url=https://app.mediafire.com/k43u5kzgqczqz]🔗 Download Now[[/url]/b]

https://app.mediafire.com/k43u5kzgqczqz



📈 [h3][u][b]What's Next?[/b][/u][/h3]

I’m continuing to update the game monthly, with new content, improvements to older sections, and bug fixes based on community feedback.

Once we reach around 10,000 Steam wishlists, we plan to begin releasing every new version of the game directly on Steam, so you'll always have the latest build right here.

Thank you again for playing and supporting MMA Life Simulator. Your enthusiasm drives this project forward, and I can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.

— The Developer
MMA Life Simulator Blade7

notes.title: New version of MMA life simulator
notes.content:
🎉 MMA Life Update 0.2.4 Playtest Release!

We’re excited to announce that Update 0.2.4 will be available this week exclusively for our playtesters on Discord!
What’s New?

The game has greatly expanded since the last time you played, with:

    New quests and storylines.
    Enhanced gameplay mechanics.
    Fresh content to explore!

Join the Conversation

We’d love to hear your feedback! Be sure to join our Discord server and share your thoughts about the latest update. Your input is invaluable in helping us shape the best experience possible.
